	c.TelegramToken = env("TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN", "")

	c.SlackWebhook = env("SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL", "")
	c.NotifyTrades = yes(env("QUANTOSS_NOTIFY_TRADES", "no"))

	// 안전장치
	c.FlattenOnExit = yes(env("QUANTOSS_FLATTEN_ON_EXIT", "yes"))
	c.DataStallSeconds, e = envI("QUANTOSS_DATA_STALL_SECONDS", c.DataStallSeconds)
	set(e)

	return c, c.Validate()
